'''Peert Ginzork''' was the assumed name of an ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and the leader of [[The Shield]]. Patient and an experienced soldier, Ginzark deserted from the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] where he had been serving as an [[assault trooper]]. He would later emerge several years later leading The Shield, a small militant group that was feeding funds and supplies to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives. Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he wedded fellow operative [[Filice Ginzork]].

==Biography==
Peert Ginzork served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army trooper]]. He deserted in the middle of deployment and went underground for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before emerging under the assumed name 'Peert Ginzork'. He met [[Filice Ginzork]] sometime after that and the two maintained a relationship for many years before they were eventually married around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="CRO" />

Peert also set up [[The Shield]], a private security company focused on protecting corporate couriers. He later expanded their business to include executive bodyguarding and counter-espiionage. Secretly the organization were operatives working for [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] under [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Peert was the assumed name of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was very symapathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] cause. He tempered his physical training with patience.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Peert was highly trained in most forms of combat being an excellent shot with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and artillery. He was also skilled at piloting [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles and other ground vehicles. Peert was also an effective leader.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
In combat Peert carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and a [[Blast vest/Legends|protective vest]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peert Ginzork was designed by [[Rick Olshak]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].
